events.title: 셰필드 웬즈데이 record a 5–1 home win over 윔블던.
첼시 crush 맨체스터 유나이티드 5–0 – the first domestic competitive game that United have lost for nearly nine months. Alan Shearer scores twice as 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 미들즈브러 2–1.

A Premier League thriller at Goodison Park sees 에버턴 and 리즈 유나이티드 draw 4–4, a result that ends the Yorkshire club's 10-match winning streak. Elsewhere, a late Trevor Sinclair equalizer for 웨스트햄 유나이티드 stops ten-man 선덜랜드's ascension to the top; the Black Cats instead rise to third.
Dutch club 스파르타 로테르담 fires manager Jan Everse , who is replaced by Dolf Roks .
Manager Herbert Neumann is fired at Dutch club 피테서 . Ronald Koeman will replace him on 1 January 2000. In the meantime former player Edward Sturing takes control.

October draws to a close with 리즈 유나이티드 as the new Premier League leaders, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 in second place and trailing them by two points. 아스널, 선덜랜드 and 레스터 시티 complete the top five. 셰필드 웬즈데이 remain bottom, with 왓퍼드 and 브래드퍼드 시티 completing the bottom three. 맨체스터 시티 lead Division One, with 입스위치 타운, 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 버밍엄 시티 level on points as their nearest rivals. 허더즈필드 타운 and 풀럼 complete the top six.
